    # Define symbols
    m_cart, m_pendulum, l, g, q1, q2 = symbols('m_cart m_pendulum l g q1 q2')
    q1d, q1dd = dynamicsymbols('q1 q1d q1dd')
    q2d, q2dd = dynamicsymbols('q2 q2d q2dd')

    S_cart = slider.frame

    O_pendulum = O_cart.locatenew('O_pendulum', l * S_cart.z)

    cart = RigidBody('cart', O_cart, S_cart, m_cart, (inertia(S_cart, 0, 0, m_cart), O_cart))
    pendulum = RigidBody('pendulum', O_pendulum, S_pendulum, m_pendulum, (inertia(S_pendulum, 0, 0, 0), O_pendulum))
